Coniinum Bromatum.



Crystallised Bromohydrate of Conicine. C 6  H 17  NHBr.



Clinical. ─   Head, empty sensation in. Inactivity.
        Mental apathy.



Characteristics. ─     Conii.
        bro  . has produced symptoms of mind and head. Coffee dissipated them.



SYMPTOMS.



1. Mind. ─   Difficulty in intellectual work.  ─  State
        of inactivity, rather than a tendency to sleep.



2. Head. ─   Cerebral emptiness and vertigo.
